description: JSP/1 snapshot compliance corpus for issue 476 J1 slice. Each entry names a fixture file and its expected parse result.

fixtures.name: snapshot_full
fixtures.description: Canonical full snapshot exercising every required field with supported authoritative/inferred known states, known-empty (null) optional entities, and known-non-empty todos.

fixtures.name: snapshot_identity_distinct
fixtures.description: Same repository/path as snapshot_full but distinct agent_id/lifecycle_generation/source_epoch/pid so the live observation key stays distinct.

fixtures.name: snapshot_field_states
fixtures.description: Exhaustive field-state coverage: inferred unknown, authoritative degraded, known-empty todos (revision 1, zero items), authoritative known source-error state, explicit permission wait.

fixtures.name: snapshot_bounds
fixtures.description: At-limit agent_id (128 bytes) and minimal valid todos. Exercises the upper inclusive bound for identity strings.

fixtures.name: snapshot_todo_states
fixtures.description: Every recognized todo task state (pending, in_progress, completed), a state outside the recognized vocabulary which must be accepted and read as neither completed nor active rather than guessed, and an at-limit 64-byte state exercising the inclusive state bound.

fixtures.name: snapshot_forbidden_fields
fixtures.description: Valid snapshot shape plus forbidden credential (publisher_token, observer_token) and forbidden control/raw fields (raw_transcript, draft, control). Closed parser must reject at ingress.

fixtures.name: snapshot_closed_grammar
fixtures.description: Valid snapshot with an unknown top-level field and an unknown nested field inside native_session. Closed-object semantics must reject unknown fields.

fixtures.name: snapshot_semantic_failure
fixtures.description: Producer-supplied stale tool phase (stale is a transport-health overlay, not a producer value) and otherwise valid shape. Must fail semantic validation with no payload echoed.

fixtures.name: snapshot_nested_forbidden_fields
fixtures.description: Forbidden credential, transcript, and control members nested inside current_wait.value rather than at the top level. The closed contract applies at every depth, so these must be rejected at ingress and never echoed.

fixtures.name: snapshot_over_bound
fixtures.description: Tool label one byte over the 256-byte inclusive bound. Limit-plus-one input must fail before a contract value is returned.

fixtures.name: snapshot_unsupported_version
fixtures.description: Otherwise-valid document declaring schema 2. There is no legacy or unknown-version fallback.

fixtures.name: snapshot_invalid_identity
fixtures.description: Zero lifecycle_generation. The live observation key requires a positive generation, and this is an identity violation rather than a shape error.

fixtures.name: event_activity_changed
fixtures.description: Activity transition to acting

fixtures.name: event_wait_opened
fixtures.description: Explicit blocking request opens a wait

fixtures.name: event_turn_ended
fixtures.description: Turn ends with an explicit outcome

fixtures.name: event_todos_replaced
fixtures.description: Full todo replacement with revision

fixtures.name: event_tool_created
fixtures.description: Tool call created in awaiting_approval

fixtures.name: event_message_displayed
fixtures.description: Committed assistant reply became visible

fixtures.name: event_session_ended
fixtures.description: Payload-free session end

fixtures.name: event_unknown_type
fixtures.description: Unknown event type is rejected, not ignored

fixtures.name: event_forbidden_fields
fixtures.description: Credential/control members inside an event payload

fixtures.name: event_stale_phase
fixtures.description: Producer cannot assert stale

fixtures.name: event_invalid_identity
fixtures.description: Zero lifecycle generation

fixtures.name: heartbeat_full
fixtures.description: Heartbeat carries liveness without a transition

fixtures.name: heartbeat_with_sequence
fixtures.description: Heartbeat must not carry a sequence
